segments.description: Host introduces the cheesy beefy potato casserole recipe.
Host adds ground beef to the skillet and breaks it down while discussing lean cuts.
Showing ground beef cooking in its natural oil in the skillet.
Adding diced onions to the beef and cooking until translucent.
Squeezing garlic paste into the skillet with meat and onions.
Sprinkling garlic powder over the ground beef mixture.
Host explains why combining garlic paste and garlic powder enhances flavor.
Adding onion powder to the seasoning mix in the pan.
Sprinkling smoked paprika for a smoky flavor element.
Pouring Worcestershire sauce over the browning meat.
Stirring the seasoned beef and allowing spices to integrate.
Host talks about seasoning choices and salt control.
Adding tomato paste into the center of the pan and mixing.
Pouring beef broth into the skillet and stirring.
Host holding red pepper flakes before adding them to the pan.
Sprinkling red pepper flakes into the ground beef and stirring.
Host explains the second stage involving cubing and parboiling potatoes.
Host shows the exact size of the diced potatoes in her hand.
Host explains the necessity of parboiling potatoes before assembling.
Pouring cubed potatoes into salted boiling water.
Greasing the ceramic casserole dish with oil using a paper towel.
Transferring parboiled potatoes to the casserole dish.
Seasoning potatoes with salt, pepper, olive oil, and tossing.
Layering cooked ground beef on top of the seasoned potatoes.
Mixing cream of mushroom soup with milk in a measuring jug.
LADLING cream mixture evenly over the beef and potato layer.
Host gives oven temperature and foil covering instructions.
Removing foil after initial bake to reveal the steaming casserole.
Close-up of shredded mild cheddar, gouda, and mozzarella cheeses.
Generously topping casserole with mixed cheeses and fresh parsley.
Golden bubbly melted cheese casserole fresh out of the oven.
Scooping a serving of hot casserole onto a plate showing cheesy pull.
Host tastes the casserole, reacts enthusiastically, and concludes the video.
